title: The Update That Trusted an Old Version
subject: DBMS
briefing: A record editor uses optimistic concurrency: write only when the stored version still matches the version the editor originally read.
symptom: Fresh edits are rejected, while an edit based on stale data can overwrite a newer value.
hints: Compare the record's current version with the version supplied by the editor.
The version check should decide whether the write is safe before incrementing it.
A write is allowed only when currentVersion equals expectedVersion.
